labels.contactText: Tell us about your project and current situation. We will clarify the inputs, agree on the scope and prepare a proposal.
labels.indexIntro: Advertising, websites, CRM, SEO and AI: explore the scope, delivery process and related projects for each service.

services.name: Meta Ads
services.title: Real estate advertising on Facebook and Instagram
services.intro: We develop offers, creative assets and campaigns for agencies and developers. We connect campaign delivery with lead handling to assess both volume and quality.
services.fit: For individual properties, residential developments and agency offers. Best suited to projects with clear purchase terms, available property materials and a team ready to handle enquiries.
includes: Offer and audiences
We review the property, purchase terms, location and reasons to choose it, then define offers to test.
Creative assets and landing pages
We prepare messages and visuals, choose a website or lead form, and check the path to an enquiry.
Campaigns and measurement
We configure campaigns, events and lead delivery within the agreed permissions and integrations.
Management and optimisation
We compare campaign combinations, allocate budget and refine ads using sales team feedback.
steps: Review the starting point
Properties, previous campaigns, budget, website and lead handling.
Agree on the launch plan
Offers, creative assets, geography, test budget and evaluation criteria.
Launch the test
Check lead delivery and collect initial results.
Refine the campaigns
Review lead cost and quality, then agree on the next steps.
services.price: Pricing depends on the number of properties and markets, creative production and the management scope. Launch preparation and ongoing management are itemised separately in the proposal.
services.priceNote: Ad spend is separate from our fees. Photography and video production are scoped separately.
faq: Can we advertise without a website?
Yes, where a lead form suits the task. Before launch we agree where enquiries go and who responds.
Do you guarantee a fixed cost per lead?
No. Cost depends on the market, offer, competition and budget. Case study results describe previous work, not a promise to repeat that price.
What do you need from us?
Current properties and prices, purchase terms, photos or video, access to advertising assets and a person responsible for responding to enquiries.

services.name: Google Ads
services.title: Search advertising for real estate
services.intro: We work with searches from people already looking for a property or service. We connect the search query, advertisement and landing page around a specific offer.
services.fit: For projects with relevant search demand and a website where visitors can explore the offer and enquire. We assess demand, geography and landing page readiness before launch.
includes: Demand and keywords
We research commercial queries, distinguish user intent and exclude irrelevant topics.
Campaign structure and ads
We group campaigns by offer and geography, and prepare ads and supporting assets.
Landing pages and events
We check page relevance, forms and enquiry measurement. Necessary website changes are scoped separately.
Search optimisation
We review search terms, costs and conversions, then adjust negative keywords, bids and budget allocation.
steps: Assess demand
Review the offer, geography, search queries and current website.
Build the structure
Agree on campaigns, landing pages and the test budget.
Check and launch
Test conversion events and forms, then activate the campaigns.
Work with the results
Assess enquiries, exclude irrelevant queries and refine settings.
services.price: Pricing depends on the number of offers, locations, languages and the state of measurement. Setup, management and website changes are itemised separately.
services.priceNote: Google Ads spend is paid separately. New landing pages are not automatically included in campaign management.
faq: Do we need a website?
Search ads need a suitable destination. We will review the existing page and identify whether changes are needed.
How do we assess performance?
Through agreed enquiry events and lead quality. Clicks and CTR help diagnose campaigns; they do not replace enquiries and sales.
What budget do we need?
We estimate it after reviewing demand, geography and offers. We do not prescribe a universal amount without those inputs.

services.name: Website development
services.title: Websites for real estate agencies and developments
services.intro: We create landing pages, company websites and property catalogues. We design the journey from discovering an offer to choosing a property and making an enquiry.
services.fit: For a new project, an advertising launch or a website that no longer supports the product and team. We choose the format around content, traffic sources and how listings are updated.
includes: Structure and content
We define audiences, pages, materials and the main actions visitors need to take.
Design across devices
We develop the visual presentation and interface for mobile and desktop within your brand.
Development and connections
We build pages, forms and agreed integrations with property databases, CRM or other services.
Publication readiness
We check forms, links and mobile layouts, and configure basic metadata, sitemap and agreed analytics events.
steps: Choose the format
Landing page, multi-page website or catalogue, based on the task.
Agree on structure and design
Define pages, materials, visitor journeys and visual direction.
Develop
Build the interface and connect the agreed features.
Check and hand over
Publish the website, verify enquiry handling and explain how to update content.
services.price: Cost is determined by page types and count, languages, catalogue features, content management and integrations. We prepare an estimate after agreeing on structure and materials.
services.priceNote: Domain, hosting and paid services are listed separately. Post-launch support and content production are agreed as part of the scope.
faq: Can we use our existing website?
Yes. We first assess what can be kept and which changes would solve the task without rebuilding everything.
Who provides copy and photography?
At the start we agree which materials your team supplies and what needs to be produced within the project.
Is SEO included in development?
Technical preparation of the agreed pages is included. Ongoing SEO, keyword expansion and publishing content are separate work.

services.name: CRM and automation
services.title: CRM and lead automation for real estate
services.intro: We connect enquiries, properties and managers’ workflows. We configure an existing CRM or design a custom system around your agency’s process.
services.fit: When enquiries arrive through different channels, contact history is lost or managers lack a clear view of deals. We start with the team’s process, then choose the tools.
includes: Process map
We review lead sources, roles, deal stages and required follow-up actions.
Pipeline and data
We configure stages, fields, client records and property relationships in the chosen system.
Lead delivery
We connect agreed forms and sources, and check notifications, assignment and context retention.
Team launch
We test typical workflows, explain how the system works and set up agreed reports.
steps: Describe the current workflow
Identify channels, data and places where enquiries are lost.
Choose the solution
Compare ready-made CRM capabilities with custom development requirements.
Configure and connect
Build the pipeline, roles, integrations and agreed data migration.
Test the workflows
Follow an enquiry through to the manager’s next action and onboard the team.
services.price: Pricing depends on the CRM, integrations, data migration, permissions and custom development. We define the implementation scope before work starts.
services.priceNote: CRM licences, telephony and external services are paid separately. We discuss their need and costs when choosing the solution.
faq: Do we have to replace our CRM?
No. If the current system can meet the requirements, we work with its settings and integrations.
Can we migrate our existing database?
After checking structure and quality, we define what to migrate, how fields map and how to verify the result.
Will automation replace managers?
It helps transfer data, prompt actions and reduce manual work. Your team remains responsible for conversations and deals.

services.name: SEO and analytics
services.title: SEO and analytics for real estate websites
services.intro: We help search engines understand pages and teams understand enquiry sources. We review the technical foundation, site structure and performance measurement.
services.fit: For websites with crawling or indexing issues, unclear structure or incomplete enquiry data. We define scope after reviewing the website and available reports.
includes: Technical audit
We check server responses, canonical URLs, robots, sitemap, duplicates and access to important pages.
Structure and content
We map search queries to services and properties, and plan pages and internal links.
Measurement setup
We check or configure GA4, GTM, Search Console and agreed enquiry events.
Improvement plan
We prioritise changes, agree on implementation and verify the results.
steps: Collect the inputs
Website, goals, target locations and analytics access.
Run the review
Separate technical errors from structure and content tasks.
Implement agreed changes
Resolve selected issues and configure measurement.
Review the trend
Check page processing, search traffic and enquiries over comparable periods.
services.price: We can start with a standalone audit or agree on implementation and ongoing work. Pricing depends on site size, languages, technical condition and new page requirements.
services.priceNote: Article production, page development and ongoing work are itemised separately. Indexing times and search rankings are not guaranteed.
faq: When will the website appear in Google?
We can remove technical barriers and submit pages for processing. Search engines decide whether and when to index them.
Is installing analytics enough?
No. We need to define useful events, verify their delivery and distinguish visits from actual enquiries.
Do you guarantee top rankings?
No. We agree on concrete work and measurement, but do not promise positions controlled by search engines and affected by competition.

services.name: AI and automation
services.title: AI tools for real estate workflows
services.intro: We connect AI to specific tasks: understand a client’s request, find properties in your database and pass the enquiry to a manager. We use existing products or agree on a custom workflow.
services.fit: For agencies with an up-to-date property database and recurring enquiries that follow a clear process. We assess data and automation boundaries before implementation.
includes: Workflow and boundaries
We define what the system answers and when it hands the conversation to a person.
Database connection
We check the source, fields and search rules, and agree on data updates.
Interface and lead delivery
We choose a website widget or Telegram Mini App and configure branding and enquiry routing.
Response testing
We test matching and contact delivery on typical requests, including how missing data is handled.
steps: Choose the task
Define the channel, data and useful outcome of a conversation.
Agree on the product
An existing VIA package or a custom workflow.
Connect and test
Configure the database, interface and lead delivery.
Launch
Review initial conversations and the agreed scope of improvements.
services.price: Existing product packages are described in the case studies: VIA AI is $400 for Basic and $800 for Extended; VIA Properties starts at $200, or $500 with an admin panel. Custom solutions are estimated by workflow and integrations.
services.priceNote: For VIA AI, these are one-time setup fees. AI and voice service usage is billed separately. See each product page for the package scope.
faq: Does AI invent properties?
Property matching uses the connected database. During setup we check how the system handles missing information and no matching results.
Can it connect to our database?
We first check the format and access method. A supported source and a custom integration require different amounts of work.
Where can we see the product?
The VIA AI and VIA Properties case studies show interfaces and workflows. Send an enquiry to discuss a demonstration and setup.
